title: Closure edges
description: The edges the matrix's dependency relationships between what the Tasks build make between Tasks of different Stories (<work>/closure-edges.json): the step `beadwrite.closure_task_edges` (orchestrator/flows/task_edges.py) writes beadwrite.closure_task_edges' result and validates it against this file. The task-dependency-mapper is handed it as `closure edges`: these edges stand, and the mapper adds only edges they do not hold.

from.description: The prerequisite Task key, S<i>-<local key>.

to.description: The dependent Task key, S<i>-<local key>.

kind.description: What the dependent Task needs from the prerequisite (task-deps.schema.json, TaskDepsEdgeKind).

reason.description: Which item requires which, and through which matrix relationship.

warnings.description: Each requirement no Task of the span builds; a warning fails the step.
